releaseNotes: Hardening release: automatic updates now verify (and repair) Elmashad's Excel registration before any update is committed - a broken or missing registration can no longer be committed as success
New: the working registration is captured with every update backup and restored automatically on rollback
New: Elmashad.Updater.exe repair-registration - an external recovery entry point for registration issues
New: developer builds can no longer alter the machine's Excel registration; the test suite is registry-isolated and guard-verified
Fix: fresh installs of prerelease builds now default to the correct update channel (prerelease payloads check the beta endpoint)
Update: version floor authority tightened - Installed Apps metadata can never outrank the actual installed binaries
